description: This file defines the ClusterMembershipSnapshot class, which represents a snapshot of the cluster's membership state in an Orleans-based system. It includes properties for members and version, methods to evaluate silo status, create updates, and output its state as a string.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipSnapshot
classes.description: Encapsulates a snapshot of the current cluster membership, including the set of members and the version of the snapshot. Provides methods for status retrieval, creating updates, and string representation.

methods.name: ClusterMembershipSnapshot
methods.description: Constructor that initializes Members and Version properties.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Provides a default, empty snapshot with minimum version.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specific silo, determining if it is dead or unknown based on the snapshot.

methods.name: AsUpdate
methods.description: Returns a ClusterMembershipUpdate reflecting this snapshot's current state.

methods.name: CreateUpdate
methods.description: Generates an update comparing this snapshot to a previous one, listing changed, new, or removed members.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the snapshot, including version and member details.
